name: mirage
text: I read the code for both numbers. The equations are right. Daily profit: each bet counts on its game's day (Eastern, 5 am to 5 am). Profit is the sum of settled bets only: a win pays stake x (1/cost - 1), a loss is -stake, a push gives back what it cost, voids are left out. Open bets are shown as money at stake, never as a loss. So a day with nothing settled shows $0.00. All-time profit: wallet now (cash + what open bets cost) minus money put in, net of money taken out, with deposits and withdrawals read from Novig's ledger. A second check from the ledger alone (settlements and maker credits minus fills and fees) should agree. Two things I did not prove: (1) whether a bet's cost always includes the fee. The code says the price includes it, but I did not trace every path. (2) hand bets whose fills could not be read (the HB1 error) may carry an estimated cost. The best test is the app's own two all-time figures. If the wallet figure and the ledger figure differ by more than a few cents, tell me the two numbers and I will find the missing row.
